primary_window.rationale: 20% history / 80% scored suffix. Not chosen freely for this audit: independently pre-adopted by 3 of the 4 new external-baseline runners before this protocol existed -- LRB's --validation-fraction default (0.2), 3L-Cache's --validation-fraction default (0.2), and HALP's training_trigger default (10000 of 50000 = 0.2). Adopting the same boundary for the fairness comparison reuses an existing, independently-converged-upon choice rather than introducing a new one post hoc.

deployment_window.rationale: Matches the manuscript's existing, already-published end-to-end replay protocol (Table: 'mean replay misses ... 50,000 requests/trace', main.tex ~line 401) for evict_value_v1 and the 7 original baselines. Retained as a secondary/diagnostic comparison, not overridden.

metric.identity_required: hits + misses == scored_requests for every row
